fields.name: cube_placed
fields.description: Whether the robot itself has already dropped the goal cube onto goal_target during execution. 'no' at every step until the decision step whose execution steps show the robot release the cube (fingers widen back to ~100% while low) with the cube lying within about 6 pixels of goal_target; 'yes' from that step on. e.g. no

fields.name: goal_target
fields.description: The [y, x] of the target the goal instruction names: the one the demonstration placed the goal cube on right before the button press if the goal says 'before', or right after it if the goal says 'after'. Found by reading the whole demonstration. The press frame is the first demonstration frame where the fingers go to 0% open with height under 0.05 and the gripper over the button. A release is a frame where the fingers widen from ~46% to 88% or more with height under 0.05. If the goal says 'before', take the last release earlier than the press frame; if it says 'after', take the first release later than the press frame (a later put-away release, where the cube ends more than 8 px from every target, is ignored). The goal cube's position in that release frame is the placement point; the field holds the [y, x] of the target entry nearest that point as listed in the scene at the start of execution. Written at the first decision step and never changed afterwards. e.g. [86, 100]
